text: Based on the data, there was deforestation on the asset in 2023. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) observed tree-cover loss of 0.7 hectares, which is about 1.2% of the asset's area. The European Commission's Joint Research Centre (JRC) Global Forest Cover 2020 data corroborates this, showing that the entire area was mapped as forest in 2020. The Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) forest map from 2021 indicates that the area was planted forest, not native forest. Although there was some loss in patches under 0.5 hectares (not counted as an event), the overall observation supports that deforestation did occur in 2023.
